description: This file defines the 'Group' class, which extends 'User' within the SuiteCRM project. It manages group-specific behaviors such as overriding attributes, construction, delete marking, and export query creation, with access control based on admin status.

classes.name: Group
classes.description: Represents a user group, extending the User class with specific overrides and methods for group management.

methods.name: mark_deleted
methods.description: Overrides the SugarBean method to mark the group as deleted, only if the current user is an admin.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Generates an SQL query to export user data, with access control and optional ordering.
